newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle at $72, up $1 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle at $72, up $1 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was active in the Panhandle area early Wednesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were $1.00 per cwt higher. Feedlots reporting good inquiry from buyers.

Sales reported on 10,900 slaughter steers and 11,800 heifers; 44,500 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 10,800 formulated cattle and 100 previously contracted to be shipped this week and 1,500 head or 41 loads of CME cattle delivered to area packing plants.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs 72.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 72.00.
